title: Prompt Engineering vs Context Engineering vs Harness Engineering Explained
description:
Prompt Engineering vs Context Engineering vs Harness Engineering Explained
Description:
Prompt engineering is only one layer.
Discover how prompt engineering, context engineering, and harness engineering work together to transform an LLM from a simple response generator into an AI agent that can use tools, verify results, recover from failures, and complete real tasks.
Prompt tells the model what to do.
Context gives it what it needs to know.
Harness enables it to act.
Subscribe to Brainy Algorithms to stay informed and understand what matters in AI.
